text:
zoe: opening a tiny docs PR to swap verbose function-calling examples for compact envelopes + add a full appendix. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1991
pete: compact examples will help the quickstarts. keep one full dump in appendix for debugging.
sam: please also fix that dead anchor from the migration guide to the schema appendix while you're at it. i hit it earlier.
zoe: good catch, will patch the anchor and add a cross-link from docs/migration/structured-output.md to the appendix.
mia: ops note: new models emit `invocation`; older SDKs may show `tool_call`. docs should present `invocation` as canonical and mention `tool_call` in parentheses.
docs-bot: reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and mark the PR as docs-only so it skips gated deploys.
pete: for snippets show this fallback pattern (py):
```python
resp = client.invoke(...)
out = resp['output'].get('compact')
if not out:
    out = resp['output'].get('raw_text', '')
```
sam: one-liner under snippet: "Prefer `compact` for deterministic parsing; `raw_text` is the fallback for legacy/unstructured outputs."
zoe: will update snippets/python and snippets/js, patch the links, add changelog, and include a tiny docs CI grep that looks for `compact` or `raw_text` in invoke snippets. requesting review from @pete and @sam.
pete: happy to review, quick CI lint seems fine.
docs-bot: PR updated: link fix, snippet changes, changelog added. CI run queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/556677889
